mechanism.insert: canPlaceItem and menu mayPlace use EquipmentHandler.isAccessory. Quickmove player->box filters accessories; box->player uses native moveItemStackTo. Rightclick outside selfGui first simulates whole transfer, then safeTake/actual Hopper add or clears cursor. Real insertion remainder not checked in these helpers; no transaction guarantee.
mechanism.decode_boundary: Reader does not call accessory predicate; historical contents are not sanitized based on current insertion policy. Accessory base definition includes rods, BaubleItem or recognized mana item; isAccessory overrides/platform handler loading not audited.
mechanism.lifetime: Use sets open=true before opening menu; removed resets false server-side. onDestroyed gets saved inventory, passes nonempty stream to native onContainerDestroyed, then clearContent. Native delivery success/clear persistence not traced.
